title: Root
description: What spatial programming primitives does an AI agent need to construct persistent memory structures in the Memory Palace? Think about: coordinate-based addressing, region binding, z-order layering, checkpointing spatial state, and automated building placement. Current API: walk, enter, building_list, vision. What's missing for an agent to programmatically build a spatial knowledge graph?

children.title: Multi-Modal Memory Encoding
children.description: Integrate multi-modal data sources (e.g., audio, video) for enhanced memory encoding.

children.title: AI-Assisted Region Binding
children.description: Use AI to automatically bind regions of the memory palace to specific concepts or memories.
enables: Dynamic adaptation of memory layout based on user behavior
Enhanced accessibility for users with disabilities
risk: Potential accuracy issues in binding, leading to confusion

children.title: Spatial Version Control
children.description: Implement version control for the spatial memory structures, allowing tracking and reverting changes.
enables: Facility for experimentation without loss of original data
Collaborative editing features among multiple users
Audit trails for security and compliance
risk: Potential performance overhead due to versioning

children.title: Augmented Reality Overlay
children.description: Provide an augmented reality overlay that visualizes the memory palace structure in real-world environments.
enables: Enhanced immersion and ease of navigation
Mobile accessibility, allowing users to interact with memories on-the-go
Integration with other AR applications for a more connected experience
risk: Compatibility issues across different devices and platforms

children.title: Cross-Platform Synchronization
children.description: Enable seamless synchronization of memory palace structures across multiple devices (e.g., desktop, mobile, smartwatch).
enables: Flexible access to memories from any device
risk: Security risks associated with cross-platform data transfer
Complexity in maintaining consistent state across devices

children.title: Automated Memory Recall Training
children.description: Create an automated system that trains users on recalling memories by simulating different traversal scenarios.
enables: Enhanced memory retention and retrieval skills
Personalized training based on user performance
Integration with neurofeedback technologies for optimized learning
risk: Potential issues with accuracy in simulated scenarios
Dependence on system's ability to understand user's recall patterns
